content: Firestore security rules for single-admin write access: hardcoding request.auth.uid == 'ADMIN_UID' is simplest and appropriate for a true single-admin app (email-based checks are spoofable/changeable, UID is stable and immutable). Rules only govern client SDK; Admin SDK bypasses rules entirely. Public collections should have allow read: true, allow write: if false by default, with explicit admin-UID exception on write.
